name: spring-boot-testing
description: Writes and fixes Spring Boot 3/4 tests that need a Spring context. Covers test slices (@WebMvcTest, @DataJpaTest, @RestClientTest, @JsonTest, @WebFluxTest), @MockitoBean and @MockitoSpyBean, MockMvcTester, RestTestClient, Testcontainers with @ServiceConnection, Spring Security tests, and slow suites that rebuild the application context.
